meta.name: bgpt-paper-search
meta.description: Search scientific papers and retrieve structured experimental data extracted from full-text studies via the BGPT MCP server. Returns 25+ fields per paper including methods, results, sample sizes, quality scores, and conclusions. Use for literature reviews, evidence synthesis, and finding experimental details not available in abstracts alone.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 搜索科学论文并提取结构化实验数据
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要从全文论文中快速获取实验数据细节。
copy.tagline_en: Search papers and extract structured experimental data.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need detailed experimental data from full-text papers.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会通过 BGPT 服务搜索论文,并返回论文的结构化实验数据,包括方法、结果、样本量、质量评分和结论等 25 多个字段。
howto.when: 当你想搜索带具体实验细节的论文、做系统性文献综述,或需要跨研究比较定量结果时触发。

say.text: 帮我搜索 CRISPR 基因编辑在人类细胞中效率的论文
say.note: Claude 会调用搜索工具并返回论文列表。

say.text: 找 5 篇关于抑郁症治疗的论文,列出样本量和方法
say.note: 返回的结果会包含质量评分和结论。

say.text: 搜索比较不同化疗方案效果的论文,给出定量结果
say.note: Claude 会返回带数值结果的结构化数据。

howto.what_en: Claude connects to the BGPT paper service, searches papers on request, and returns structured experimental data including methods, results, sample sizes, quality scores, and conclusions (25+ fields).
howto.when_en: Triggers when you search for papers with specific experimental details, conduct systematic literature reviews, or compare quantitative results across studies.

say_en.text: Search for papers on CRISPR gene editing efficiency in human cells
say_en.note: Claude calls the search tool and returns a paper list.

say_en.text: Find 5 papers on depression treatment with sample sizes and methods
say_en.note: Results include quality scores and conclusions.

say_en.text: Search for papers comparing chemo regimens and show quantitative results
say_en.note: Claude returns structured data with numeric findings.
